fresh_held_out_cohort_readiness.limitation: Seven reviewed development witnesses establish readiness for a fresh held-out check, not generalization or C2 acceptance.
fresh_held_out_cohort_readiness.rationale: All 19 scored supported effects and all 20 scored capability/dependency labels are recovered, and every adjudicated semantic field is exact. The remaining effect predictions are explicit taxonomy gaps; the two extra dependency records and one extra label are reviewed Tetra mechanics outside the scored-atom denominator. Relationship scoring remains diagnostic rather than independently metric-scored.

phase3_summary.relationship_scoring_limit: The evaluator has no independent expected relationship-ID denominator; resolved targets, operations, ownership, and unresolved references are preserved in per-witness diagnostics for review.
